rv.q: If there’s a do-not-miss musical thus far this year, “Charlie and Lucy” is it.
This absolutely wild world premiere play follows two newlywed "first-generation Asian American renegades" on a crazy, unplanned, financed-by-robbing-a-convenience-store post-nuptial vacation...
This new play is wacky, earnest, hilarious, and harmonious as it tracks the post-shotgun wedding hijinks of Charlie and Lucy.
The result is a show you should absolutely add to your list for the summer.
Let yourself get into this play's energy, as it is a delightful production that will have you laughing all day.
The absurd premise disarms with charm and sneaks in topics of cultural relevance while your guard is down.
With us handily distracted, Lucy and Charlie made off with all our hearts.
It’s a wide-ranging, often hilarious, attempt to satirize and in its own way, the Yee script certainly makes a definitive point or two.
The solidness of the production shows just how strong Lookingglass is in its ability to bring exciting new works to Chicago.
Lucy and Charlie’s Honeymoon was a delightfully entertaining and hilarious theatrical treat that you do not want to miss.

cn.t: Critics embrace this energetic world-premiere musical about Asian American newlyweds-turned-outlaws, praising its audacious blend of country-western music, sharp satire, and exploration of identity through a zany road-trip adventure.
